From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Investor package: final edits, SLO callouts & OKR highlights

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the draft. We need to lock the investor packet for distribution to the board and top-tier investors by EOD Thursday (9/16). Key asks:

- Evelyn: highlight 3 OKR callouts on slide 4 (growth, latency & reliability) with one-line status and a coverage metric where possible.
- Jonas: please confirm ARR bridge numbers and add one consolidated table (slide 7); we want a single source-of-truth for the deck.
- Lauren: wording for the risk slide (compiler/runtime risk exposure) — keep it concise; there will be Qs.
- Stephanie: coordinate final legal checklist + confirm if procurement needs to sign the redlines.

I attached the latest deck (Q3_board_packet_draft_v3.pptx) and the OKR tracker. Put any micro-edits directly in the slide notes or reply-all with short bullets.

We should aim for one round of light edits (typo/clarity) and one sign-off pass. If anyone expects a delay, flag immediately.

Thanks —
Mike
Michael Grant
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_board_packet_draft_v3.pptx (presentation), OKR_tracker_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Investor package: final edits, SLO callouts & OKR highlights

Mike — thank you. Quick notes from an OKR check:

- Growth OKR: organic usage up 9% QoQ, paid trials up 14% (slide 4 line). Recommend we show "Trials -> Paid" conversion funnel (3 bullets) not full funnel to keep slide simple.
- Latency/Reliability: we hit 99.6% p99 in Aug after kernel improvements; still working on cold-start mitigation. Suggest we put p50/p95/p99 in a small table under the SLO callout.
- Risk callout: add note that Dedicated capacity rollout will reduce per-token cost but introduces schedule risk for a subset of customers — short sentence only.

Question for Jonas: the deck shows a $3.2M uplift in the ARR bridge — is that net of churn adjustments? I don't want the board surprised on the math.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Product Marketing

Evelyn / Mike —

I pulled the revenue model and adjusted the bridge table. Short answers: the $3.2M uplift is gross; you need to subtract the $450k expected churn adjustments to get to our reported net ARR change (slide 7). I've attached a small spreadsheet with the waterfall (ARR_bridge_v2.xlsx).

I've added one consolidated table to slide 7 and left a note in the slide comments calling out the assumptions (pricing promo uptake, invoice timing). If the board wants a slide that shows sensitivity to churn +/- 200bps, I can add that as an appendix but would prefer to keep the main deck lean.

Also flagged: legal asked me to avoid forward-looking phrasing on slides 2 and 8 — changed a line to 'expected' rather than 'will'.

-Jonas
VP, Finance Operations

Attachments: ARR_bridge_v2.xlsx

Hi all —

Reviewed slides 1–14 and left detailed copy edits in the notes. A few high-level suggestions:

- Slide 3 (TL;DR): shorten the second bullet to one line — investors want quick takeaways.
- Slide 7 (ARR bridge): show the net row we discussed; keep the gross numbers in the appendix.
- Slide 12 (Risk & Mitigations): trim to 3 bullets. I attached a tiny notes file with suggested language to keep it tight (slide12_notes.txt).

Two style points: avoid industry jargon on the top-level summary (e.g., "KV cache" -> "request-level cache"). Also, can someone confirm the color palette is final? I left the palette comment in slide 2.

Lauren
Director, Corporate Communications

Attachments: slide12_notes.txt
